title: Divers discover ancient Bronze Age sword off the coast of England

title: US, FG unveil digital Nok heritage platform to preserve over 250 ancient artefacts
description: The Federal Government, in partnership with the United States Embassy and the Wheyham Report Foundation, on Tuesday unveiled an immersive digital heritage platform designed to preserve Nigeria’s ancient Nok civilisation, with more than 250 artefacts digitally catalogued and protected against illicit trafficking.
